decisions.statement: Which files hold the rows is answered by the caller rather than here.
A page hands over every numbered entries file beside that page.
A file beside a page that is not there is no file to read.
A file that would not read is named rather than counting as no runs.
A row a write left half appended is passed over and the rest of the file read.
The file that row is in is named among the files a row would not read in.
Which rows count as runs is answered by the caller rather than here.
The runs are gathered under what the row says ran.
A window is chosen by the rule the check measuring chooses one by.
A window of runs counts the most recent run ids rather than the most recent rows.
The rows are ordered by what their runs took on average.
No page is reached through the index here.
Every row is drawn with the ceiling the caller hands over.

definition: the runs an entries file holds, gathered under what ran and weighed over a window
